Home.title: Printable booklet
Home.description: Turn your images into a printable booklet. Fold, staple, and share your own zine.
Home.imagesHint: The order you select the images determines the page order in the final booklet — first selected goes on page 1.
Home.notEnoughFiles: You must select at least {totalPages} images.
Home.instructions1: 1. Print in both sides of the paper.
Home.instructions2: 2. Cut the spreads (pages who should be side by side).
Home.instructions3: 3. Arrange the spreads in the correct order.
Home.instructions4: 4. Find the middle of the booklet and fold it in half.
Home.instructions5: 5. Staple or bind the folded booklet.
Home.sheetsRequired: First select the number of sheets

About.title: About me
About.description:
Hi, there! I hope you enjoyed using this tool as much as I enjoyed building it. I'm a frontend developer with a passion for self-publishing, zines, artsy stuff, pixel art and a bunch of other non-tech related things. I also happen to find open-source cool as hell, sort of a positive punk attitude in the face of the big tech giants and consumerism culture we live in. Thus, this project you are now seeing was born.

If you want to know more about me, you can find me at GitHub or LinkedIn.
